messages:
incbot: INCIDENT ALERT: auth0-introspect upstream errors detected. spike in 5xx/502 and 429 from auth0.introspect API, affecting token verification for web sessions. paging @eric_oncall and @praveen_sre. Please ack and start mitigation.

eric_oncall: acked. oncall here, I'm looking at graphs. seeing a sharp jump in introspect latency from ~40ms -> 1.2s, and error rate to ~12% across eu/north-America. console login errors starting ~12:03 UTC.

praveen_sre: on it. checking service logs for downstream 502 patterns. Looks like our authz-proxy is returning 502/401 for a subset of tokens when introspect times out. rate limit headers from auth0 show: `X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0` for a small fraction of tenants.

jules_platform: adding context: we rolled a small change to session-cache eviction yesterday but it's not in path for introspect calls. this smells like an upstream throttle or regional degradation at auth0.

maya_support: support queue is lighting up. multiple enterprise customers reporting console login failures and API token verify errors. top ticket: ACME corp - they cannot access the admin console.

sophia_prodeng: quick customer-impact calc: our telemetry shows ~8% of interactive logins failed in the last 20m, console access errors worse for higher-rate tenants. Severe for org admins doing bulk actions.

eric_oncall: mitigation plan options: 1) Switch token verification to local cache fallback for recently-seen tokens (risk: accepts stale tokens for short window). 2) Enable more aggressive retry/backoff to Auth0 (risk: amplify auth0 rate limits). 3) Route authz verification to secondary region where auth0 is healthy (if available). 4) Short-lived maintenance page for console.

praveen_sre: we should avoid spamming auth0 with retries. recommended: enable local-introspect-cache fallback + graceful degradation for console (show limited UI but allow read-only). Start config toggle: `AUTH0_INTROSPECT_CACHE_FALLBACK=true` for gateway.

jules_platform: I can flip that toggle in staging and then prod- can we do a canary for low-traffic region first? Also I'll patch the gateway to return 200 with limited-scopes if cache hit but outside introspect window.

eric_oncall: do it. canary to us-west-2 (10% of traffic) first. if green for 5m, promote.

praveen_sre: creating quick backup route to our internal session verifier: `curl -X POST https://internal-verif.redwood/api/v1/bulk
 -d '{"tokens": [..]}'` . It will accept tokens validated within last 15m. Doing a warmup.

jules_platform: flipping the feature in us-west-2 now. command:
```
kubectl set env deploy/authz-gateway AUTH0_INTROSPECT_CACHE_FALLBACK=true -n prod-us-west-2
```

maya_support: notifying affected customers: sending proactive message to enterprise contacts about degraded logins with recommended retry and alternative admin API keys. Draft:
"We're seeing degraded login validation via Auth0 in some regions. Engineers have enabled a temporary cache fallback to reduce login failures while we work with Auth0. You may see slightly delayed token revocations."

tim_sales: flagged to account execs for highest value customers (ACME, Nimbus). They want ETA and impact. Please provide a short summary for customer comms.

eric_oncall: canary looks okay after 4m: error rate down from 12% -> 2% in canary region. Promoting to all regions.

jules_platform: rolling to all prod regions now. `kubectl rollout restart deploy/authz-gateway -n prod` across clusters. ETA ~3-4m.

praveen_sre: also reduced our downstream call concurrency to auth0 from 50 -> 20 and enabled a 500ms circuit-backoff after 3 consecutive errors to avoid thundering herd.

incbot: SYSTEM: change request recorded: CR-2412345678 by jules_platform at 12:16 UTC. Link: https://redwood.incidents/2412345678

maya_support: support queue trending down slightly, some customers still seeing console refresh errors (token revalidate). We're applying targeted session-fix for affected orgs.

sophia_prodeng: quick note on risk tradeoffs: using cached introspect means revocations may be delayed up to 15m. We should call this out in customer comms and in support runbook.

praveen_sre: contacting Auth0 SRE via support channel and provided diagnostic bundle (logs, rate-limit headers, tenant ids). Waiting on update.

eric_oncall: monitoring dashboards: login success rate trending to normal (errors ~1.8%). We'll hold until stable for 30m then start downshift.

tim_sales: customers on slack contact appreciated the proactive note, but they want a postmortem and root cause when available.

praveen_sre: Auth0 replied: they are throttling a batch of tenants due to upstream capacity issue; mitigations underway but no firm ETA. They advised reducing burst concurrency per-tenant.

jules_platform: adjusted per-tenant throttle buckets in our gateway: burst limit now 5 requests/sec for introspect per tenant. Also added small randomized jitter on retries.

maya_support: update: ACME reported console access restored at 12:28 UTC after rollout. Closing their ticket.

incbot: NOTE: escalation to ENG-SRE if error rate rises >4% in next 45m.

sophia_prodeng: summary for customers:
- Impact: token verification failures causing login errors and console access degradation for ~8% of interactive login attempts for a subset of tenants.
- Mitigation: enabled local introspect cache fallback, reduced per-tenant introspect concurrency, and added circuit backoff to limit bursts against Auth0.
- Tradeoffs: token revocation/revocation-list latency increased up to ~15m for cached tokens.
- Next steps: coordinate with Auth0 for permanent fix, add hard rate-limits and smoother failover path, update runbook and postmortem.

eric_oncall: handing off to praveen_sre for monitoring and post-incident actions. praveen, please own the postmortem. I'll be available for any followups.

praveen_sre: taking postmortem ownership. capture timeline, root cause (Auth0 throttling batch of tenants), RCA hypothesis: upstream capacity + our unthrottled bursts. Action items:
- (P1) Update runbook: enable-introspect-cache, when and how, and customer comms template. Owner: jules_platform. Due: 48h.
- (P2) Implement per-tenant token verification rate-limits and burst smoothing. Owner: praveen_sre. Due: 72h.
- (P3) Add synthetic tests for auth0 introspect latency and circuit-breaker triggers. Owner: eric_oncall. Due: 7d.
- (P4) Request Auth0 postmortem and SLA accountability for tenant throttling behavior. Owner: sophia_prodeng. Due: 48h.

maya_support: will compile affected customer list and publish to internal status page; also coordinate refunds/credits if required.

tim_sales: please cc me on postmortem for any customer-sensitive wording.

incbot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigations active, error rate <2%, incident moved to monitoring at 12:42 UTC. No ongoing paging. Link: https://redwood.incidents/2412345678/status

praveen_sre: final note: we'll keep circuit backoff in place for 24h and then evaluate. Closing thread after postmortem plan kicked off. If error rate spikes back, re-open and page.

eric_oncall: thanks team. good triage and fast mitigation. :thumbsup:

sophia_prodeng: filing postmortem ticket now and adding stakeholders.
